title: Warp-hole infinite ping-pong — player stuck teleporting A<->B forever, can't get out
summary: User report: 'go in a warp, get teleported, but can't get out.' Live-reproduced. Root cause is in `examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/warp-hole-system.ts`. The 0.3 s cooldown (line 108: `if (simTime - entry.lastWarpAt < COOLDOWN_SECONDS) continue`) is **per-pair**, not **per-entity**. Once the cooldown expires, the system looks at occupants of A + B again and teleports anything still standing there. Because the bomber/bomb landed on the destination cell at the moment of the previous warp and didn't move during the 0.3 s window, it gets warped right back. The cycle continues forever: A → B (cooldown 300 ms) → A → B → A. From the player's POV: 'I stepped on a warp and now I'm flickering between two squares and can't break out.' The story summary explicitly claims the cooldown is meant to 'prevent infinite ping-pong' (warp-hole-system.ts:8-12), so the implementation diverges from the design intent. The 11 unit tests in `tests/unit/warp-hole-system.test.ts` cover single-direction warp + cooldown-suppressed-second-warp, but no test exercises the 'occupant lingers past cooldown' case — that's exactly the path the user hit.
repro: Open `?project=kaboom-crew` in a tab and start the game (Space).
Switch to the warpfield arena: in DevTools `__agf.kaboom.loadMap('warpfield')`, then press Space again.
Walk player.1 onto any warp-A cell (pairId=0 default is at (2,1); use ArrowKeys or `__agf.kaboom.gotoCell(2,1)`).
Watch: every ~300 ms the player teleports between A and B and back. The player can't step off — the warp re-fires the moment cooldown lapses.

Live evidence (Playwright on port 5180, origin/main HEAD 347bf6c, warpfield map): forced player onto (2,1) → polled GridPosition every 100 ms for 3 s → trace shows 12,9 ↔ 2,1 every 100-500 ms with no input.
Tighter probe: `setInterval(() => { fetch('/__agf/component/player.1/GridPosition').then(r=>r.json()).then(j=>console.log(j.payload.value)); }, 100)` while standing on a warp.
expected: Stepping on a warp cell teleports the bomber/bomb to the partner cell EXACTLY ONCE. Subsequent warps require the entity to LEAVE the destination cell and step back onto a warp. The per-pair cooldown is fine as a debounce for two bodies on the same pair, but it shouldn't re-warp the same entity that just arrived. From the player's POV: walk in → arrive at the other end → walk away normally. No ping-pong.
actual: Per-pair `lastWarpAt` stamp expires after 300 ms; the system then re-scans occupants and warps anything still on a warp cell. Anyone who can't step off in 300 ms (which is half the default GridMover step time at speed=4 → 250 ms PER CELL, so the next step often hasn't even completed yet) gets ping-ponged.
